hero.filename: Headstone of Eliza Murphy, Island Eddy. Co. Galway.jpg
hero.caption: The headstone of Eliza Murphy, Island Eddy. Galway Bay, Ireland.  The inscription reads: 'Erected in Memory of Eliza Murphy Who died April the 8th AD 1827 aged 17 Months'. Note the profusion of Comfrey surrounding the headstone.
hero.alt: The headstone of Eliza Murphy, Island Eddy. Galway Bay, Ireland.  The inscription reads: 'Erected in Memory of Eliza Murphy Who died April the 8th AD 1827 aged 17 Months'. Note the profusion of Comfrey surrounding the headstone.

images.filename: Seaweed Mearing Stone bearing the number 22, Island Eddy, Galway Bay.jpg
images.caption: This Seaweed Mearing Stone is one of series of roughly dressed limestone pillars erected on the intertidal zone along the South Mallmhuir, Island Eddy. These stones marked the boundaries between the plots from which seaweed was harvested.  Probably late 18th or early 19th century in date.
images.alt: This Seaweed Mearing Stone is one of series of roughly dressed limestone pillars erected on the intertidal zone along the South Mallmhuir, Island Eddy. These stones marked the boundaries between the plots from which seaweed was harvested.  Probably late 18th or early 19th century in date.

images.filename: Series of Nausts on the North Mallmhuir, Island Eddy, Galway Bay.jpg
images.caption: This view, looking NW, shows Naust nos. 6-8 of the series of 15 which are cut into the shingle and cobble shoreline of the North Mallmhuir. The boat (MV Robert Lloyd - length 4.9m) is moored in No. 6.

images.filename: Castle Site, Island Eddy, Galway Bay.jpg
images.caption: This view, looking east along an old boundary wall, shows the only surviving piece of masonry of the the castle on Island Eddy. It is first mentioned in  1574, but appears to have been reduced to its present state by the 1830s if not before.
